name: DS · input, new 03 · Amount to send
title: Amount to send

catalogue.note: The 2.0 amount input on its 272-wide card. Drawn in Figma at 0.75 of real size (0.75 stroke, 9 radius, 4.5 gap, 18/10/9 type): built at 362.67×160 with every value divided by 0.75: 96-high input, 12 radius, 1px stroke of black at 2%, type 24/13.33/12. The component is 320 wide here and 312 inside the full-dress screens (the card is 272 with 16 padding, the screens 270 with 18); height, radius and amount type are the same in both. The frame is 363 wide, the last third of a pixel is white. The card’s own 8px corners are left off. The naira sign is not in Satoshi (the files on this Mac hold 431 glyphs, none of them U+20A6) and Figma draws it from a fallback face, the same outline at every weight: it is Figma’s own outline of the glyph, inline, 0.572em wide. The SF Pro Display symbols (chevrons, info, close, arrow) are Figma’s outlines of those text nodes; SF Pro is not among the project fonts. Figma snaps each text baseline to a whole pixel at its own small scale, so some lines sit up to 1px lower in Figma than in a browser; they are left where the browser puts them. Edges that fall on fractions of a pixel are blurred over two rows by Figma and snapped to one by Chrome. Flat fills match exactly.
